name: ICAM Founder Panel Material System
principle: smoky graphite layered matte surface, not flat dark UI
materialRules: No large flat single-color dark surfaces
Use subtle radial haze on the page background
Cards receive a soft top/internal fill rather than glossy reflections
Keep border contrast low and shadows broad/soft
Semantic color occupies small areas only
Green is a semantic status accent, not the interface base color
